Definition: from G4111; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively):--table.
BiblicalUsage: Plax is a tablet, a flat surface for writing. Paul says believers are the epistle of Christ, written not on tables of stone but on fleshly tables of the heart, in 2 Corinthians 3:3. And the ark held the tables of the covenant in Hebrews 9:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God moved His writing from stone to hearts, and I am the tablet now.
